title: Sleepy penguin
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="30" ry="27" fill="#3b4a8c"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="21" ry="21" fill="#e8eef9"/>
    <!-- flippers -->
    <ellipse cx="20" cy="68" rx="7" ry="17" fill="#2f3d78" transform="rotate(12 20 68)"/>
    <ellipse cx="80" cy="68" rx="7" ry="17" fill="#2f3d78" transform="rotate(-12 80 68)"/>
    <!-- feet -->
    <ellipse cx="38" cy="92" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#ff9a3c"/>
    <ellipse cx="62" cy="92" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#ffb54d"/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="23" fill="#3b4a8c"/>
    <!-- face patch -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="17" ry="15" fill="#e8eef9"/>
    <!-- eyes: sleepy, closed -->
    <path d="M38 40 q5 4 10 0" stroke="#3b4a8c" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M52 40 q5 4 10 0" stroke="#3b4a8c" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- beak -->
    <path d="M46 48 q4 6 8 0 q-4 3 -8 0z" fill="#ff9a3c"/>
    <!-- blush -->
    <ellipse cx="35" cy="47" rx="4" ry="2.6" fill="#ff9dc0"/>
    <ellipse cx="65" cy="47" rx="4" ry="2.6" fill="#ff9dc0"/>
    <!-- sleepy z -->
    <path d="M74 26 h7 l-7 8 h7" stroke="#9fd4ff" stroke-width="2.4" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
</svg>
